description: This is a test class for the ImageAspectRatio validation rule in the OrangeHRM Corporate Branding API validation rules. It defines a unit test for verifying the correct validation of image aspect ratios based on provided image file data.

classes.name: ImageAspectRatioTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the ImageAspectRatio validation rule.

methods.name: testValidate
methods.description: Tests the validate method of the ImageAspectRatio rule with different aspect ratio data sets.

methods.name: dataProvider
methods.description: Provides a set of aspect ratio test cases with associated file data and expected validity.
